entities.name: Alistair Graye
entities.description: An unpredictable and powerful individual bound by a deal with Mephisto, utilizing a card system and a smile mechanism that resets memories.
entities.quote: The problem with Alistair Graye was not that he was powerful was not that he was unpredictable was not even that he seemed to find the entire engagement mildly amusing

entities.name: Damian

entities.quote: Damian's entry had none of these things until the camera pulled back far enough to find him already there already in motion
